monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The home-testing guide is a high-intent, product-neutral system comparison, but it adds no merchant, model, price, coupon, ranking, product image, or affiliate link.

image_qa.note: All three new pages use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. Stem Cell CBG had the strongest supported opportunity at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0, so exactly one Data-led page expands the CBG evidence cluster with a distinct official variety record rather than another rewrite of Stem Cell CBG. One-impression legal queries, Montana at two impressions, navigational About and Contact impressions, and Blue Dream terms near position 48–70 were ignored as too small, navigational, or outside the supported 4–20 range.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready federal-housing issue-spotter with a program-identification table, admission-versus-tenancy matrix, six-question rule screen, medical-marijuana accommodation boundary, notice-response packet, and direct HUD/eCFR sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the federal property, state-law, official-source, and housing cluster. The HURV19PAN page also preserves an official variety-to-lot evidence chain. No outreach was sent.
